title: Tortoise: a p-type-only organic thin-film transistor time-race classifier (simulation study)
description:
Tortoise is a 6-input, 5-class linear classifier designed to be built only from p-type organic thin-film transistors (DNTT-family OTFTs on an AlOx/SAM dielectric, 134 transistors, single 3.3 V rail). Each class integrates its weighted input current onto a rail capacitor; then all rails race to a common threshold and the first to arrive latches and locks out the others. The repository holds the design (netlists, compact-model cards, specification), the simulation tooling, and the protocols, per-run data and reports of the ngspice simulation campaigns.

Simulation only: nothing has been fabricated or measured, and the dataset is synthetic. No patent has been filed or will be claimed on this design; it is published for open research use.
